notes: Reading teams, projects, cycles, issues, labels, and comments
runs automatically. Creating or updating an issue, posting a
comment, or setting labels/assignee/status is write-tier —
confirm before the first write and always show the proposed
issue title, description, and labels. Archiving an issue is
modify-tier because it removes the issue from default views.
Deleting an issue, project, or comment is destructive-tier —
Linear does not support undo on delete. Unlisted actions are
bumped one tier above the conservative default per the design
